description: Details required by Condition 6 (Trees and landscaping) of planning permission 25/05289 (Extension of closet wing across all floors to match rearwards projection of neighbouring properties; lowering of lower ground floor level; construction of a single storey rear extension at lower ground floor level; construction of a rear infill at ground floor level; installation of metal doors and Juliet balcony at rear ground and first floor level; replacement of windows throughout with double glazed timber units; reconfiguration of front entrance steps to allow access to lower ground floor level; replacement of front railings; internal reconfiguration of two flats; creation of a roof terrace at main roof level with an openable rooflight to facilitate access)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
